subject: Zone-level demand forecasts
body: Hi Priya, your team's September post at Lumen said stockouts in new zones run at 9% with city-level forecasts. At Fernleaf Grocers I rebuilt forecasting at store-zone level, and stockouts in new zones fell from 11% to 6% in one quarter. Is the Senior Data Analyst role at Lumen still open? If someone else owns it, a name is plenty.

R1.text: Lumen Grocers engineering blog, 2026-09-02: we still forecast demand per city, and stockouts in new zones run at 9%.
